reviewer: independent read-only subagent; looked only at the 21 sheets; not a human sign-off

unblinding.reviewer_labels: [S] smooth hand, [L] rough hand, assigned from appearance

findings_by_priority.observation: At shoulder flexion and abduction extremes and arms overhead, the pauldrons stay put and hang under the raised arm; thin slivers stretch from the armpit.
findings_by_priority.plan: helper-bone rule: pauldron turns by a share of the upper arm rotation, evaluated in the runtime evaluator; armpit strap weights

findings_by_priority.observation: Hip flexion extreme splits the skirt into a dark wedge; hip abduction shears side panels; knee flexion extreme crushes the calf and the boot cuts the hem.
findings_by_priority.plan: helper-bone rules: coat panels and tabard follow a share of thigh rotation; knee volume corrective

findings_by_priority.observation: At spine extremes the chest armour bends like rubber while the belt and skirt stay put.
findings_by_priority.plan: make the armour region of the core move with spine_02 only, bending left to the waist

findings_by_priority.observation: At the elbow extreme the forearm armour cuts into the pauldron and the elbow collapses.
findings_by_priority.plan: re-measure after pauldron follow; elbow volume corrective

findings_by_priority.observation: At neck pitch extreme the chin sinks into the collar; at yaw extreme the jaw skews.
findings_by_priority.plan: collar rigid with the chest; review neck range

findings_by_priority.observation: All joints pose with no spikes or seams and are acceptable at gameplay distance; close up the palm looks inflated, knuckles undefined, the fist is a block, MCP flexion folds four fingers into one plate, PIP extreme forms a hard wedge.
findings_by_priority.plan: knuckle volume correctives on flexion; shape changes to the protected r010 Basis would need authorization

baseline_vs_candidate: Body rows identical as expected (the body ratchet holds the candidate at baseline level). Hand rows favour the candidate in most rows; the baseline cannot pose DIP.L, thumb IP or any fist or grasp.
reviewer_caveats: hand close-ups use a per-subject camera, so A/B hand views differ in angle
320 px tiles hide small intersections; toe and whole-body combo tiles too small to judge
